item.quote: We had the absolute best time ever! Everything was easy to find and lines were quick. Not to mention the best concert I’ve ever been to!
item.name: Jina

item.quote: Red Clay Strays sounded amazing! Great acoustics in the Moda Center, great food at Dr Jack's beforehand. Very fun date night with my wife at the Rose Quarter.
item.name: Michael

item.quote: Such an amazing experience! Daniel Caesar was incredible live, and the energy from the crowd made the whole night unforgettable. One of the best concerts I’ve been to! Definitely an unforgettable night.
item.name: Destiny
